CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2588 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a. Bus nonce: f8eeaf3fe4d4c22a030ca34706a11ee6. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a` or `Fix review: blocked ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: f8eeaf3fe4d4c22a030ca34706a11ee6`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2588 ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2588-f8eeaf3f`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Re-review of PR #2588 (branch fix/audit-r10-roster-pr; the round-10 roster PR, which lands origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster on main) at the UNCHANGED head ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a. The previous verdict at this same head (review/2588, probe rev-2588-566ff789) was blocked figure-wrong on ONE body line: the carry_audit check line. It said every other figure re-derived and every earlier block was cleared. A body-only seat has since re-cut that line and reworded the P22 Forward-carry bullet. The new body was applied at this head with no code change (the live body equals origin/handoff-body/audit-r10-roster 940c524d). The roster ref is frozen at 306a96d5f, so nothing under the head moved.
Scope: confirm the block is cleared and that the body edit introduced nothing new. Do not re-litigate the parts the previous verdict accepted unless the code or roster changed (it did not; check git rev-parse origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster == 306a96d5f21f7876070d48c194fd4be99b64022c and the PR head == ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a).
Required:
- Run every command printed in the body beside a figure, and report each figure as re-derived or not re-derivable. In particular: `python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body <live body>` must print what the body says (expected `2 finding item(s): 2 routed, 0 unrouted, 0 bad destination(s)`), and the sweep line must match its own stated command.
- The P22 bullet must locate the 'checked out elsewhere' exit by its message text, and must state that its counts are out-of-tree and are re-measured by the fixer.
- policy_lint --pr-body with pr-contract's arguments passes on the live body.
- ## Red checks: read the check-runs API per commit at this head (nightly-status grades main; main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT).
- git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a must be clean; do not ask for a main absorb on a clean head.
- Every Carry in your own verdict names a live group (stage not done).
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full 40-hex head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: f8eeaf3fe4d4c22a030ca34706a11ee6.
Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
